items.title: Does low back pain improve following supervised patient education and exercise therapy targeting hip osteoarthritis symptoms? A longitudinal cohort study of 5014 patients.
items.summary: A longitudinal cohort study of 5014 hip OA patients, 61% with comorbid LBP, found significant LBP intensity reductions at 3 months (19% improvement) and 12 months (21% improvement) following a supervised education and neuromuscular exercise program, with greater improvements in hip OA responders.
items.curatedReason: 数据显示，腰髋部共病患者在接受针对髋关节骨性关节炎的康复项目后，腰痛强度有显著改善。这提示你，对髋关节 OA 患者进行规范化教育和运动治疗时，也能同时获益于腰痛管理，尤其是那些对髋关节 OA 治疗有良好反应的患者。
items.titleZh: 针对髋关节骨性关节炎症状的患者教育和运动疗法，能否改善共病腰痛？一项针对 5014 名患者的纵向队列研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 5014 名髋关节骨性关节炎 (OA) 患者的纵向队列研究显示，其中 61% 伴有腰痛 (LBP)。在为期 8 周的监督教育和神经肌肉运动项目后，患者的 LBP 强度在 3 个月时改善了 19%，在 12 个月时改善了 21%，且髋关节 OA 治疗响应者 LBP 改善更显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study shows that patients with co-occurring hip and low back pain experience significant reductions in LBP intensity after participating in a supervised exercise and education program for hip OA. This suggests that structured hip OA rehabilitation can also effectively manage LBP, especially for patients who respond well to hip OA treatment.
items.limitation: 这是一项纵向队列研究，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在未调整的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This is a longitudinal cohort study, which cannot establish causality and may have unadjusted confounding factors.

items.title: Next-generation control strategies for lower-extremity exoskeletons: State-of-the-art, limitations, and future directions.
items.summary: This review explores state-of-the-art control strategies for lower-extremity exoskeletons in gait rehabilitation, highlighting current limitations in user intent detection and adaptability. It discusses emerging approaches like brain-computer and peripheral nerve interfaces that aim to enable more natural and autonomous mobility.
items.curatedReason: 当前下肢外骨骼在步态康复中的用户意图检测和适应性仍是主要瓶颈，这篇综述指出了脑机接口、外周神经接口等前沿技术将是实现更自然、自主运动的关键。这些技术有望大幅提升患者的功能独立性，你现在就能开始了解它们了。
items.titleZh: 下一代下肢外骨骼控制策略：现状、局限和未来方向。
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述审视了步态康复中下肢外骨骼的控制策略，强调了当前用户意图检测和适应性方面的局限。文章探讨了脑机接口和外周神经接口等新兴方法，旨在实现更自然、更自主的行动能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Current lower-extremity exoskeletons still face significant limitations in user intent detection and adaptability for gait rehabilitation. This review highlights that advanced technologies like brain-computer and peripheral nerve interfaces are crucial for achieving more natural and autonomous movement, which could significantly boost functional independence. It's time to start familiarizing yourself with these advancements.
items.limitation: 作为一篇综述，它总结了现有技术，但没有提供新的临床证据或系统性分析。
items.limitationEn: As a review, it summarizes existing technologies but does not provide new clinical evidence or systematic analysis.

items.title: Clinical approach to balance intensity in people with multiple sclerosis: clinical judgment versus the Balance Intensity Tool for Exercise - an inter-rater agreement and reliability study.
items.summary: A study in 61 PwMS introduced the Balance Intensity Tool for Exercise (BITE), a standardized method for assessing balance intensity based on observable errors, demonstrating excellent inter-rater reliability (ICC > 0.9) and narrower limits of agreement compared to clinical judgment.
items.curatedReason: Balance Intensity Tool for Exercise (BITE) 为多发性硬化症患者的平衡训练强度提供了一个可量化的评估方法，优于传统的临床判断。这可以帮助你更精准地设计和调整平衡训练方案，提高康复干预的标准化和可靠性。
items.titleZh: 多发性硬化症患者平衡训练强度的临床评估：临床判断与平衡训练强度工具（BITE）的比较——一项评价者间一致性和可靠性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 61 名多发性硬化症患者的研究引入了平衡训练强度工具 (BITE)，该工具基于可观察的错误来标准化评估平衡强度，显示出卓越的评价者间可靠性 (ICC > 0.9) 和比临床判断更窄的一致性界限。
items.curatedReasonEn: For balance training in PwMS, you now have a more reliable quantitative tool than traditional clinical judgment: BITE. This study demonstrates BITE’s superior inter-rater reliability (ICC > 0.9), which can help you design and adjust balance training programs with greater precision.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且仅限于多发性硬化症患者，结果外推到其他平衡障碍人群时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size and was limited to PwMS, so caution is needed when generalizing results to other populations with impaired balance.

items.title: Preoperative factors associated with quadriceps strength 1 year after total knee arthroplasty: a prospective longitudinal study.
items.summary: A prospective longitudinal study (n=39) found that higher preoperative normalized quadriceps strength (B=0.72, 95% CI: 0.40 to 1.0) and Limb Symmetry Index (LSI) were significantly associated with better normalized quadriceps strength 1 year after TKA in older adults with uncomplicated recovery.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 39 人的观察研究提示，如果 TKA 术前股四头肌强度和肢体对称性指数（LSI）较高，患者术后 1 年的股四头肌强度表现也会更好。这意味着术前加强股四头肌训练可能至关重要，你应该在术前康复中更关注这些指标。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术 1 年后股四头肌强度相关的术前因素：一项前瞻性纵向研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性纵向研究（n=39）发现，在接受全膝关节置换术后 1 年，术前较高的标准化股四头肌力量（B=0.72，95% CI：0.40 至 1.0）和肢体对称指数 (LSI) 与术后更好的标准化股四头肌力量显著相关，此发现适用于术后恢复顺利的老年患者。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study of 39 individuals suggests that higher preoperative quadriceps strength and Limb Symmetry Index (LSI) are associated with better quadriceps strength one year post-TKA. This implies that strengthening quadriceps pre-surgery may be critical, and you should prioritize these metrics in your pre-rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性研究，样本量较小（39 例），且仅限于恢复顺利的患者，结果需要大型研究进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This was an exploratory study with a small sample size (39 participants) and was limited to patients with uncomplicated recovery, so larger studies are needed for confirmation.

items.title: Low-frequency deep brain stimulation promotes long-term orofacial motor recovery after traumatic brain injury: A case study
items.summary: A first-in-human case study demonstrated that low-frequency continuous deep brain stimulation (DBS) of the motor thalamus (55 Hz over 3 years) promoted progressive recovery of facial symmetry, resolved laryngeal penetration, and improved speech intelligibility in a patient with severe diffuse axonal injury and chronic dysarthria/dysphagia.
items.curatedReason: 这个病例研究首次展示了低频脑深部电刺激（DBS）对创伤性脑损伤（TBI）后口面部运动功能长期恢复的潜力。它提示你，DBS 可能为慢性 TBI 患者的言语和吞咽障碍提供新的治疗窗口，即使在移除刺激后也能维持部分改善。
items.titleZh: 低频脑深部电刺激促进创伤性脑损伤后口面部运动功能的长期恢复：一个病例研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项首次人体病例研究显示，对一名患有严重弥漫性轴索损伤和慢性构音障碍/吞咽困难的患者，持续 3 年的 55 赫兹低频运动丘脑深部电刺激 (DBS)，促进了面部对称性的逐步恢复，解决了喉部穿透，并显著改善了言语清晰度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case study is the first to demonstrate the long-term potential of low-frequency deep brain stimulation (DBS) for orofacial motor recovery after traumatic brain injury (TBI). It suggests that DBS might offer a new therapeutic window for speech and swallowing disorders in chronic TBI patients, with some improvements sustained even after stimulation cessation.
items.limitation: 这是一项单一病例研究，结果的普适性非常有限，需要在更大样本的临床试验中进行验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-case study, with very limited generalizability, and requires validation in larger clinical trials.

items.title: Patient experiences with a prescription-based digital health application (DiGA) for knee disorders: a qualitative study in german orthopaedic care.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 10 German patients with knee disorders found prescription-based digital health applications (DiGAs) were valued for flexibility and bridging physiotherapy gaps, especially in prehabilitation, but noted limitations in personalization and integration.
items.curatedReason: 针对膝关节疾病的处方数字健康应用（DiGA）被患者视为物理治疗的有效补充，尤其在术前康复和维持治疗方面。但在个性化、可用性和与现有医疗整合方面仍有改进空间。
items.titleZh: 膝关节疾病患者对处方数字健康应用（DiGA）的体验：德国骨科护理中的一项定性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对德国10名膝关节疾病患者的定性研究发现，处方数字健康应用（DiGA）因其灵活性和弥补物理治疗空白的特点而受到患者的重视，特别是在术前康复中。然而，研究也指出DiGA在个性化和整合方面的局限性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Prescription-based digital health applications (DiGAs) for knee disorders are perceived by patients as a valuable complement to physiotherapy, particularly for prehabilitation and continuity of care. However, there is room for improvement in personalization, usability, and integration with existing healthcare structures.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性探索性研究，样本量小（10名患者），观察期短，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative exploratory study with a small sample size (10 patients) and short observation period, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Can Clinicians Predict Which Patients Respond Best to a Specific Treatment? A Systematic Review of Low Back Pain Moderators in Primary Care.
items.summary: A systematic review of 73 studies on low back pain moderators found highly heterogeneous literature and poor quality of moderation analyses, with no clearly important moderators identified, suggesting clinicians cannot reliably predict treatment response.
items.curatedReason: 关于腰痛治疗效应调节因素的证据尚不明确，临床医生在预测哪些患者对特定治疗反应最佳方面仍缺乏支持。在将特定治疗推荐给特定人群时，应继续依赖现有指南和高质量证据。
items.titleZh: 临床医生能否预测哪些患者对特定治疗反应最佳？初级保健中腰痛调节因素的系统综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对初级保健中腰痛治疗调节因素的系统综述（73项研究）发现，现有文献高度异质，调节分析质量普遍不佳，未能明确识别出重要的调节因素，提示临床医生尚无法可靠预测患者对特定治疗的反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence on treatment effect moderators for low back pain remains inconclusive, and clinicians lack robust support for predicting which patients respond best to specific treatments. Continue to rely on existing guidelines and high-quality evidence when recommending specific treatments to patient subgroups.
items.limitation: 纳入的73项研究高度异质，很少重复调查相同的干预-调节因素组合，且调节分析质量普遍不佳，难以得出确切结论。
items.limitationEn: The 73 included studies were highly heterogeneous with little replication of intervention-moderator combinations, and moderation analysis quality was generally poor, making definitive conclusions difficult.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Robot-assisted gait training for adult neurological rehabilitation in acute National Health Service settings: Physiotherapists' perceptions before implementation.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 11 UK physiotherapists found cautious optimism towards robot-assisted gait training (RAGT) in acute neurological settings, citing benefits like increased intensity and reduced therapist burden, but emphasizing the need for structured implementation and support.
items.curatedReason: 在英国急性神经康复环境中，物理治疗师对机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）持谨慎乐观态度，认为其能提高训练强度、促进早期活动并减轻治疗师负担。若考虑引入RAGT，需关注实施策略、培训和组织支持。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态训练在英国急性国家医疗服务体系神经康复中的应用：实施前物理治疗师的看法。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对11名英国物理治疗师的定性研究发现，他们在急性神经康复环境中对机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）持谨慎乐观态度，认为其益处包括提高训练强度和减轻治疗师负担，但强调了结构化实施和支持的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Physiotherapists in acute neurological rehabilitation settings in the UK hold cautious optimism towards robot-assisted gait training (RAGT), believing it can increase training intensity, promote earlier mobilization, and reduce therapist burden. If considering RAGT implementation, focus on structured strategies, training, and organizational support.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（11名英国物理治疗师），所有受访者均为女性，结果可能不具有广泛代表性。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative study with a small sample (11 UK physiotherapists), all female, which may limit generalizability.

items.title: Benefits and limitations of robotic gait exoskeletons in functional rehabilitation of children with cerebral palsy: an umbrella review.
items.summary: An umbrella review on robot-assisted gait training (RAGT) for children with cerebral palsy found improvements in overall motor function (GMFM-88 dimensions D and E), but inconsistent benefits on spatiotemporal gait parameters, suggesting RAGT is a valuable adjunct rather than a superior alternative to conventional therapy.
items.curatedReason: 机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）可作为脑瘫儿童康复的有效辅助手段，尤其能改善总体运动功能，特别是GMFM-88的D和E维度。但在改善时空步态参数方面，RAGT并未显示出优于传统或跑步机训练的持续优势，因此应将其视为补充疗法。
items.titleZh: 机器人步态外骨骼在脑瘫儿童功能康复中的益处与局限性：一项伞形综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项关于脑瘫儿童机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）的伞形综述发现，RAGT能改善整体运动功能（GMFM-88的D和E维度），但在时空步态参数方面益处不一，表明RAGT是传统疗法的有益补充而非优越替代。
items.curatedReasonEn: Robot-assisted gait training (RAGT) can be an effective adjunct for children with cerebral palsy, particularly in improving overall motor function, specifically GMFM-88 dimensions D and E. However, RAGT does not consistently outperform conventional or treadmill training in improving spatiotemporal gait parameters, so it should be considered a complementary intervention.
items.limitation: 这是一项伞形综述，其结果受限于纳入研究的异质性，且未报告其他临床、运动学、动力学或肌电图测量。
items.limitationEn: This was an umbrella review, whose results are limited by the heterogeneity of included studies and the lack of reporting on other clinical, kinematic, kinetic, or EMG measures.

items.title: Adding blood flow restriction to low-load resistance training for sarcopenia and cognitive function in oldest-old adults: an exploratory randomized controlled trial
items.summary: An exploratory RCT (n=36) found that supervised low-load BFR-RT improved handgrip strength (P=0.012), 4-m walk time (P=0.044), verbal learning (P=0.003), and delayed recall (P=0.002) in oldest-old adults with sarcopenia and MCI compared to no exercise. Evidence for additional benefits of BFR over matched low-load RT was limited.
items.curatedReason: 对于同时患有肌少症和轻度认知障碍的极老年患者，如果他们难以耐受传统高负荷抗阻训练，可以考虑尝试低负荷血流限制抗阻训练（BFR-RT）。这项小样本RCT显示，BFR-RT 能显著改善他们的握力、4米步行时间、言语学习和延迟回忆能力，尽管其优于单纯低负荷抗阻训练的额外益处有限。
items.titleZh: 血流限制结合低负荷抗阻训练对极老年肌少症和认知功能的影响：一项探索性随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性随机对照试验（n=36）显示，对于同时患有肌少症和轻度认知障碍的极老年患者，在监督下的低负荷血流限制抗阻训练相比无运动对照组，能改善握力（P=0.012）、4米步行时间（P=0.044）、口语学习（P=0.003）和延迟回忆（P=0.002）。与单纯低负荷抗阻训练相比，血流限制的额外益处有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: For oldest-old adults with sarcopenia and MCI who struggle with conventional high-load resistance training, low-load BFR-RT appears to be a viable alternative. This small RCT indicates BFR-RT significantly improves their handgrip strength, 4-meter walk time, verbal learning, and delayed recall, though its added benefits over low-load RT alone are limited.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性单盲试验，样本量较小，且注册为回顾性，部分结果稳健性较低。
items.limitationEn: This was an exploratory single-blind trial with a small sample size, retrospectively registered, and some findings showed less robustness.

items.title: Postoperative rehabilitation after medial meniscus posterior root repair: a scoping review of published protocol descriptions and evidence gaps
items.summary: A scoping review of 69 studies found that postoperative rehabilitation protocols for medial meniscus posterior root repair inconsistently describe active and functional rehabilitation, despite frequent reporting of weight-bearing, ROM, and bracing. Milestones often reflect published descriptions rather than validated progression thresholds.
items.curatedReason: 现有内侧半月板后根修复术后康复方案缺乏标准化，主动功能性康复描述不足。你在制定康复计划时要留心，现行里程碑多是文献复述而非实证，应更多关注个体化与功能性进展。
items.titleZh: 内侧半月板后根修复术后康复：已发表方案描述与证据空白的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述涵盖 69 项研究，发现内侧半月板后根修复术后康复方案在主动和功能性康复描述上不一致，尽管负重、活动度和支具使用报告频繁。现有里程碑多反映已发表描述，而非经确证的进展阈值。
items.curatedReasonEn: Existing rehabilitation protocols after medial meniscus posterior root repair lack standardization, with active functional rehabilitation being inconsistently described. Be mindful when developing rehab plans, as current milestones often reflect literature review rather than evidence-based thresholds. Focus more on individualized and functional progression.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，而非系统评价，无法评估干预措施的有效性。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review, not a systematic review, and cannot assess the effectiveness of interventions.

items.title: Effects of repeated-sprint training in hypoxia on repeated-sprint and sprint performance in athletes: a systematic review and three-level meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis (10 studies, n=216) found that repeated-sprint training in hypoxia (RSH) had a significant small effect on improving repeated-sprint performance (Hedges' g = 0.31, 95% CI [0.12, 0.50], P=0.001), particularly sprint time/RSA time (g=0.34) and sprint decrement (g=0.53), but evidence certainty is very low and benefits for power/work output remain uncertain.
items.curatedReason: 低氧重复冲刺训练（RSH）可能改善运动员的重复冲刺表现（如冲刺时间/RSA 时间和冲刺衰减），但证据确定性极低。在将 RSH 作为辅助策略时，需对其效果持谨慎态度，并等待更多高质量试验的证据。
items.titleZh: 低氧重复冲刺训练对运动员重复冲刺和冲刺表现的影响：一项系统综述和三水平荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析（10 项研究，n=216）发现，低氧重复冲刺训练（RSH）对改善重复冲刺表现有显著的小效应（Hedges' g = 0.31, 95% CI [0.12, 0.50], P=0.001），尤其在冲刺时间/RSA 时间（g=0.34）和冲刺衰减（g=0.53）方面。然而，证据确定性极低，对功率/做功输出的益处仍不确定。
items.curatedReasonEn: Repeated-sprint training in hypoxia (RSH) may improve athletes' repeated-sprint performance (e.g., sprint time/RSA time and sprint decrement), but the certainty of evidence is very low. Exercise caution when considering RSH as a supplementary strategy and await evidence from larger, high-quality trials.
items.limitation: 本系统综述和荟萃分析仅纳入 10 项研究共 216 名运动员，证据确定性非常低，且主要终点效应量较小。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis included only 10 studies with 216 athletes, yielding very low certainty evidence and small effect sizes for primary outcomes.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Timed Up and Go, gait speed, and grip strength: associations and discriminative performance for falls in community-dwelling older adults - results from the KORA-age study
items.summary: A cohort study (n=1079) found that Timed Up and Go (TUG) performance was associated with reported falls in community-dwelling older adults (OR 1.095, 95% CI 1.018–1.176). However, TUG, gait speed, and grip strength showed no clear incremental discrimination beyond age and sex in identifying fallers, and established TUG thresholds had limited sensitivity.
items.curatedReason: 尽管 TUG 测试与跌倒风险相关，但它、步速和握力在区分有无跌倒史的老年人方面，增量判别能力有限。你在临床筛查时，应认识到这些测试的局限性，并综合其他风险因素考量。
items.titleZh: Timed Up and Go、步速和握力：社区老年人跌倒关联性与判别性能—KORA-age 研究结果
items.summaryZh: 一项队列研究（n=1079）发现，Timed Up and Go（TUG）表现与社区老年人报告的跌倒相关（OR 1.095，95% CI 1.018–1.176）。然而，TUG、步速和握力在区分跌倒者时，其超越年龄和性别的增量判别能力不明显，且既定的 TUG 阈值敏感性有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: While TUG is associated with falls, its incremental discriminative performance, along with gait speed and grip strength, for identifying older adults with or without falls is limited. When conducting clinical screenings, recognize the limitations of these tests and consider other risk factors.
items.limitation: 本研究数据基于自我报告的跌倒史，可能存在回忆偏倚，且为观察性研究。
items.limitationEn: This study relied on self-reported fall history, which may introduce recall bias, and is an observational study.

items.title: Impact of comfortable nursing combined with diversified health education on self-management behavior in elderly patients with cardiovascular diseases
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=142) found that comfort care combined with diversified health education significantly improved self-management behavior [CSMS total score: 116.00 (112.50, 120.00) vs 98.00 (94.00, 103.00), P < 0.001] and quality of life in elderly cardiovascular disease patients compared to routine care, with treatment adherence showing a favorable trend (92.96% vs 81.69%, P=0.044).
items.curatedReason: 舒适护理结合多元化健康教育模式能改善老年心血管疾病患者的自我管理能力和生活质量，但该研究为回顾性队列设计，且需进一步验证对治疗依从性的影响，同时关注心衰等特定人群。
items.titleZh: 舒适护理结合多元化健康教育对老年心血管疾病患者自我管理行为的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=142）发现，舒适护理结合多元化健康教育显著改善了老年心血管疾病患者的自我管理行为 [CSMS 总分：116.00 (112.50, 120.00) vs 98.00 (94.00, 103.00), P < 0.001] 和生活质量，治疗依从性也呈现良好趋势（92.96% vs 81.69%, P=0.044），优于常规护理。
items.curatedReasonEn: The combined model of comfortable nursing and diversified health education can improve self-management and quality of life in elderly cardiovascular disease patients. However, this retrospective cohort study needs further validation on treatment adherence and a focus on specific populations like heart failure.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，且样本量较小，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort study with a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: The development and psychometric evaluation of the Post Activity Symptom Scale (PASS) for Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/ Chronic Fatigue Syndrome.
items.summary: The Post Activity Symptom Scale (PASS) was developed and psychometrically evaluated, demonstrating moderate criterion-related validity (r=0.58, p<0.001), excellent discriminant validity (p<0.001), and test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.81) for measuring post-exertional malaise in ME/CFS patients.
items.curatedReason: PASS 量表为肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征患者的劳力后不适提供了一个有效、可靠且敏感的测量工具。这能让你更客观地追踪患者的症状变化，支持临床决策。
items.titleZh: 用于肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征的劳力后症状量表（PASS）的开发与心理测量学评估
items.summaryZh: 劳力后症状量表（PASS）的开发与心理测量学评估显示，该量表在测量肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征（ME/CFS）患者的劳力后不适方面具有中等准则效度（r=0.58, p<0.001）、优秀判别效度（p<0.001）和重测信度（ICC = 0.81）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The PASS scale offers a valid, reliable, and sensitive measure of post-exertional malaise in patients with Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome. This allows for more objective tracking of symptom changes and supports clinical decision-making.
items.limitation: 本研究为量表开发和心理测量学评估，仍需在更广泛的临床实践中验证其适用性。
items.limitationEn: This study focuses on scale development and psychometric evaluation; its applicability requires further validation in broader clinical practice.

items.title: Smaller Cortical Responses to Balance Perturbations in Parkinson's Disease with Freezing of Gait
items.summary: People with Parkinson's disease (PD) and freezing of gait (FoG+) showed smaller perturbation-evoked N1 amplitudes (Δ = 18.1 µV vs FoG-, p = 0.001; Δ = 14.1 µV vs older adults, p = 0.003) compared to PD patients without FoG and older adults, suggesting altered cortical activity.
items.curatedReason: 有冻结步态的帕金森病患者，其平衡受扰时大脑皮层对错误的评估信号（N1 波）幅值确实更小，比无冻结步态的患者小 18.1 µV，比健康老人小 14.1 µV。这项观察研究提示，这可能反映了辅助运动区功能改变，有助于我们理解 FoG 的神经机制。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病冻结步态患者对平衡扰动的皮层反应较小
items.summaryZh: 这项对 29 名帕金森病患者（13 名有冻结步态）和 26 名健康老年人的研究显示，冻结步态患者在平衡受扰时，皮层 N1 波幅值显著小于无冻结步态患者（Δ = 18.1 µV, p = 0.001）和健康老年人（Δ = 14.1 µV, p = 0.003）。
items.curatedReasonEn: PD patients with freezing of gait indeed exhibit smaller perturbation-evoked N1 amplitudes—18.1 µV smaller than those without FoG, and 14.1 µV smaller than healthy older adults. This observational study suggests this could reflect altered supplementary motor area function, advancing our understanding of FoG's neural mechanisms.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本观察性研究，且为预印本，未进行同行评审，结果尚需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample observational study and a preprint, lacking peer review, so the results require further validation.

items.title: Upper Limb Neurorehabilitation Using a Hybrid Technology-Enabled Therapy Approach-A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified ten articles on hybrid technology-enabled upper limb neurorehabilitation, primarily involving stroke participants aged 25-91 in hospital settings. Most studies were observational or pilot, focused on clinical feasibility, and reported positive patient outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述提示，将机器人、虚拟现实和传感器技术结合的混合技术有望应用于上肢神经康复，但目前证据多为观察性或初步研究，需要更多研究来确定其长期效果和经济效益。
items.titleZh: 混合技术驱动的上肢神经康复方法：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述共纳入 10 篇文章，评估了混合技术驱动的上肢神经康复，主要针对住院的 25-91 岁卒中患者。大多数研究为观察性或试点性质，侧重临床可行性，并报告了积极的患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review suggests that hybrid technology combining robotics, virtual reality, and sensor-based therapy holds promise for upper limb neurorehabilitation. However, current evidence is mostly observational or pilot in nature, requiring further research on long-term outcomes and economic impact.
items.limitation: 本综述纳入的研究多为观察性或试点性质，主要关注临床可行性而非确切疗效，且缺乏对参与度、长期结局和经济影响的评估。
items.limitationEn: The included studies were largely observational or pilot in nature, focusing on clinical feasibility rather rather than definitive efficacy, and lacked evaluation of participation, long-term outcomes, and economic impacts.

items.title: Identifying key components for psychosocial interventions in neurorehabilitation: a realist evaluation on young adults with an acquired brain injury.
items.summary: A realist evaluation with six young adults with acquired brain injury and seventeen service providers identified three refined program theories for psychosocial interventions: "Engaging the Individual," "Empowering the Community," and "Equipping the Professionals."
items.curatedReason: 对于年轻脑损伤患者的心理社会干预，这项研究指出了三个核心要素：促使患者参与、赋能社区支持、以及提升专业人士能力。在规划康复方案时，这些点有助于你从患者的整体需求出发。
items.titleZh: 神经康复中心理社会干预关键要素的识别：一项针对获得性脑损伤年轻患者的真实主义评估
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 6 名获得性脑损伤年轻患者和 17 名服务提供者的真实主义评估，为心理社会干预确定了三个核心理论：“促使个体参与”、“赋能社区”和“提升专业人士能力”。
items.curatedReasonEn: For psychosocial interventions in young adults with brain injury, this study identifies three core components: engaging the individual, empowering community support, and equipping professionals. These insights can help you approach patient needs holistically when planning rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 本研究的参与者数量较少，且聚焦于英国四个国家的背景，可能影响结果的普遍适用性。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small number of participants and focused on the context of four UK countries, which may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Immediate task-specific and delayed generalized adaptations to variable dual-task training in community-dwelling older adults: a randomized waitlist-controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized waitlist-controlled trial (n=50) found that 12 weeks of variable dual-task training led to immediate improvements in functional lower-limb strength (SMD = 0.54) in older adults, sustained at 3-month follow-up. Delayed improvements in functional mobility, inhibitory control, and short-term memory emerged at follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，变异双任务训练能即时改善社区老年人的下肢功能性力量，并延迟改善功能性活动能力、抑制控制和短期记忆。你可以考虑将这种变异双任务训练纳入老年患者的康复方案，尤其是在追求长期认知和运动益处时。
items.titleZh: 社区老年人变异双任务训练的即时任务特异性与延迟泛化适应：一项随机候补对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机候补对照试验（n=50）发现，12周的变异双任务训练能即时改善老年人的下肢功能性力量（SMD = 0.54），并在3个月随访中维持。功能性活动能力、抑制控制和短期记忆的延迟改善在随访时出现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that variable dual-task training immediately improves functional lower-limb strength in community-dwelling older adults, with delayed improvements in functional mobility, inhibitory control, and short-term memory. You can consider incorporating this variable dual-task training into rehabilitation programs for older patients, especially when aiming for long-term cognitive and motor benefits.
items.limitation: 该研究的局限性在于其回顾性注册试验，且部分认知和运动益处表现为延迟效应，需要进一步研究其机制。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of this study is its retrospectively registered trial, and some cognitive and motor benefits appeared as delayed effects, requiring further research into their mechanisms.

items.title: Sex-Equitable Machine Learning Prediction of Ankle Reinjury in Individuals with Chronic Ankle Instability: A 2-Year Prospective Cohort Study with Fairness Audit
items.summary: A 2-year prospective cohort study developed and internally validated sex-equitable machine learning models to predict ankle reinjury in 96 individuals with chronic ankle instability. The Elastic Net model achieved an AUC of 0.807, and applying sex-specific decision thresholds reduced the equalized-odds gap by 57% (to 0.164).
items.curatedReason: 这款机器学习模型能预测慢性踝关节不稳患者的两年内再受伤风险，并引入性别公平的阈值策略，将性别平等的赔率差距减少了57%。这提示你，未来在临床应用预测模型时，应考虑性别特异性调整，以优化不同性别的患者管理。
items.titleZh: 慢性踝关节不稳患者踝关节再损伤的性别公平机器学习预测：一项为期两年的前瞻性队列研究及公平性审计
items.summaryZh: 一项为期两年的前瞻性队列研究开发并内部验证了性别公平的机器学习模型，以预测96名慢性踝关节不稳患者的踝关节再损伤。Elastic Net模型达到了0.807的AUC，并且应用性别特异性决策阈值将性别平等的赔率差距降低了57%（至0.164）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This machine learning model predicts the 2-year re-injury risk in individuals with chronic ankle instability and, with a sex-equitable threshold strategy, reduced the equalized-odds gap by 57%. This suggests that when applying predictive models in clinical practice, you should consider sex-specific adjustments to optimize patient management across genders.
items.limitation: 该研究的局限性在于其模型需要外部验证才能在临床中部署，且尽管通过性别特定阈值降低了性别公平差距，但"不成比例影响比"仍低于理想基准。
items.limitationEn: The study's limitation is that its model requires external validation before clinical deployment, and despite reducing the equalized-odds gap through sex-specific thresholding, the disproportionate-impact ratio remained below the ideal benchmark.

items.title: Prevalence and symptom severity of thrower’s shoulder in elite youth handball players
items.summary: A prospective study of 660 elite youth handball players (52.3% boys) found that 22.4% reported shoulder problems, with an average symptom severity of 457.8 ± 352.0 points on the WOSI questionnaire. Latent class analysis showed no discernible pattern of symptom distribution.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了精英青少年手球运动员肩部过度使用症状的流行率和症状严重程度。在预防和干预青少年运动员的肩部损伤方面，可以利用 WOSI 问卷来评估症状严重程度，但要避免将其作为区分症状模式的工具。
items.titleZh: 精英青少年手球运动员投掷肩部过度使用症状的流行率与严重程度
items.summaryZh: 一项针对660名精英青少年手球运动员（52.3%为男孩）的前瞻性研究发现，22.4%的运动员报告有肩部问题，WOSI问卷的平均症状严重度为457.8 ± 352.0分。潜在类别分析未能发现明显的症状分布模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals the prevalence and severity of overuse shoulder symptoms in elite youth handball players. In preventing and intervening shoulder injuries in young athletes, the WOSI questionnaire can be utilized to assess symptom severity, but should not be relied upon to differentiate symptom patterns.
items.limitation: 本研究的局限在于其观察性设计，未能探究症状的因果关系，且WOSI问卷未能识别出不同的症状模式。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of this study lies in its observational design, which did not explore the causal relationship of symptoms, and the WOSI questionnaire failed to identify distinct symptom patterns.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The Fight Against MPPR Isn't New. And It Isn't Over
items.summary: An APTA perspective article discusses the ongoing challenges of Multiple Procedure Payment Reduction (MPPR) policies implemented by commercial payers since 2011, noting their resurfacing pace and the need for continued advocacy to protect physical therapist payment and patient access.
items.curatedReason: APTA 这篇评论强调了多重程序支付减免 (MPPR) 政策对物理治疗师报销和患者就医的持续挑战。你需要关注商业支付方不断扩大的 MPPR 政策，并积极参与行业倡导，以保护PT的合法权益和患者的治疗可及性。
items.titleZh: 反对多重程序支付减免的斗争从未停止
items.summaryZh: APTA的一篇评论文章探讨了自2011年以来商业支付方实施的多重程序支付减免（MPPR）政策所带来的持续挑战，指出这些政策再次出现的步伐，以及需要持续倡导以保护物理治疗师的报销和患者就医权利。
items.curatedReasonEn: This APTA commentary highlights the ongoing challenges of Multiple Procedure Payment Reduction (MPPR) policies on physical therapist reimbursement and patient access. You need to pay attention to commercial payers' expanding MPPR policies and actively participate in industry advocacy to protect PTs' legitimate rights and patients' access to treatment.

items.title: The Applied Sport Science of Professional Male Basketball: A Narrative Review of Current and Emerging Practices
items.summary: A narrative review explores current and emerging applied sport science practices in professional male basketball, covering training and match demands, fatigue management, recovery, nutrition, and technology. It emphasizes a holistic approach to player preparation, performance, health, and recovery.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述总结了职业男子篮球的运动科学实践，强调了通过负荷管理、营养和恢复策略来优化球员表现和健康的多面性方法。你应了解这些前沿实践，但需注意其应用复杂性和数据解读的挑战。
items.titleZh: 职业男子篮球应用运动科学：当前和新兴实践的叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述探讨了职业男子篮球中当前和新兴的应用运动科学实践，涵盖训练和比赛要求、疲劳管理、恢复、营养和技术。它强调了球员准备、表现、健康和恢复的整体方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This narrative review summarizes sports science practices in professional male basketball, emphasizing a multifaceted approach to optimizing player performance and health through load management, nutrition, and recovery strategies. You should be aware of these cutting-edge practices, but also mindful of their complex application and data interpretation challenges.
items.limitation: 本综述是叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未提供量化证据支持其提出的实践。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may be subject to selection bias and does not provide quantified evidence to support its proposed practices.

items.title: Normalization of Peak Torque in Adolescent Athletes: Which Method and What Body Parameters to Use?
items.summary: This study investigated the optimal normalization method and body parameters for peak torque assessment in adolescent athletes to improve strength measurement accuracy.
items.curatedReason: 确定在青少年运动员中标准化峰值扭矩的最佳方法，有助于你更准确地评估肌肉力量和功能，指导力量训练方案的设计和康复进展的监测。
items.titleZh: 青少年运动员峰值扭矩的标准化：应采用哪种方法和身体参数？
items.summaryZh: 本研究探讨了青少年运动员峰值扭矩评估的最佳标准化方法和身体参数，以提高力量测量的准确性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Identifying the optimal method for normalizing peak torque in adolescent athletes helps you more accurately assess muscle strength and function, guiding the design of strength training programs and monitoring rehabilitation progress.
items.limitation: 研究可能未涵盖所有潜在的身体参数和标准化方法，且青少年运动员的样本量和特异性可能限制结果的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study may not cover all potential body parameters and normalization methods, and the sample size and specificity of adolescent athletes may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: How Swing Tilt Translates into Batted-Ball Outcomes: Pitch-Type-Specific Mediation by Bat Speed in MLB
items.summary: This study examined how swing tilt influences batted-ball outcomes in MLB baseball, mediated by bat speed, in a pitch-type-specific manner.
items.curatedReason: 理解棒球运动员挥杆倾斜度如何转化为击球结果，可作为评估运动表现和设计训练干预措施的参考，尤其是通过提升挥棒速度来改善击球表现。
items.titleZh: 挥杆倾斜度如何转化为击球结果：MLB 中挥棒速度对特定投球类型的中介作用
items.summaryZh: 这项研究分析了 MLB 棒球运动员的挥杆倾斜度如何通过挥棒速度中介，在不同投球类型下影响击球结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding how swing tilt translates into batted-ball outcomes can inform the assessment of athletic performance and design of training interventions, particularly by leveraging bat speed to improve hitting.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于 MLB 棒球运动员，外推至其他运动项目或人群需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to MLB baseball players, and its findings may not be generalizable to other sports or populations.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Exercise-based rehabilitation interventions for kinesiophobia after total knee arthroplasty: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 11 RCTs (N=1,096) found that exercise-based rehabilitation was associated with a reduction in kinesiophobia (SMD = -1.22, 95% CI [-1.72, -0.72]) and improvements in knee function (SMD = 1.19, 95% CI [0.67, 1.71]) at ≤4 weeks after total knee arthroplasty, although the certainty of evidence was low and heterogeneity high (I²=93%).
items.curatedReason: 运动康复仍是全膝关节置换术（TKA）后早期（≤4周）的基石。虽然证据确定性不高且异质性大（I²=93%），但结果提示运动康复能有效降低患者的运动恐惧症（SMD = -1.22）并改善膝关节功能（SMD = 1.19）。这意味着即便有异质性，我们仍应坚持运动处方，并将运动恐惧症作为康复初期的重要干预点。
items.titleZh: 基于运动的康复干预对全膝关节置换术后运动恐惧症的疗效：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 11 项随机对照试验（N=1,096）的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，基于运动的康复与全膝关节置换术后 ≤4 周内运动恐惧症（SMD = -1.22, 95% CI [-1.72, -0.72]）的降低以及膝关节功能（SMD = 1.19, 95% CI [0.67, 1.71]）的改善相关，但证据确定性较低且异质性高（I²=93%）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise-based rehabilitation remains a cornerstone for early (≤4 weeks) post-TKA recovery. While the certainty of evidence is low and heterogeneity high (I²=93%), the findings suggest exercise significantly reduces kinesiophobia (SMD = -1.22) and improves knee function (SMD = 1.19). This means despite the heterogeneity, continue to prioritize exercise prescriptions and explicitly target kinesiophobia as a critical early intervention.
items.limitation: 研究异质性高（I²=93%），且证据确定性低，部分亚组结果因异质性过大而无法解读，需要更高质量的多中心随机对照试验。
items.limitationEn: The study exhibits high heterogeneity (I²=93%) and low certainty of evidence, with some subgroup results uninterpretable due to extreme heterogeneity, necessitating higher quality multicenter RCTs.

items.title: Midlife mobility assessment from the pocket: agreement and consistency between smartphone placement configurations
items.summary: A study on 46 adults (40-64 years) found strong correlations (rs=0.83-0.93 for balance, r=0.996 for STS repetition count) and good-to-excellent consistency between front-pocket/thigh and lower-back smartphone placements for static balance, sit-to-stand, and Timed Up and Go tests, supporting simplified, potentially unsupervised mobility monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 智能手机放入口袋/大腿位置与标准腰部位置进行平衡、坐站转换和 TUG 测试时，其移动性评估结果表现出良好的一致性。这意味着临床中可以更灵活地使用患者自带的智能手机进行初步的移动性筛查，特别是对于中老年人群，有望简化远程监测流程。
items.titleZh: 智能手机放置位置对中老年人移动性评估一致性的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对 46 名中老年人（40-64 岁）的研究发现，智能手机放置在前口袋/大腿位置与标准腰部位置进行静态平衡、坐站转换和 TUG 测试时，其移动性评估结果（如平衡、STS 重复次数 r=0.996）具有很强相关性（rs=0.83-0.93）和良好到优秀的一致性，支持简化且可能无需监督的移动性监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: Smartphone placement in the pocket/thigh shows good agreement with standard lower-back placement for mobility assessments (balance, STS, TUG). This allows for more flexible use of personal smartphones in clinical settings for initial mobility screening, particularly in midlife adults, potentially simplifying remote monitoring protocols.
items.limitation: 部分移动性参数在不同放置位置之间存在绝对值差异，提示在量化评估时仍需注意校准或进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: Some mobility parameters showed absolute value differences between placements, suggesting the need for calibration or further validation in quantitative assessments.

items.title: Comparative Effects of Neurostimulation- and Technology-Augmented Robot-Assisted Training on Upper-Limb Motor Recovery After Stroke: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 103 trials (5,251 participants) comparing various robot-assisted training (RAT) approaches for post-stroke upper-limb recovery found that rTMS plus RAT yielded the largest improvement on the Fugl-Meyer Assessment for Upper Extremity (FMA-UE) with a mean difference of 9.56 points (95% CI, 7.18-11.93) compared to usual care, followed by LFES plus RAT (MD 7.52 points).
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析指出，重复经颅磁刺激 (rTMS) 结合机器人辅助训练（RAT）在卒中后上肢运动功能恢复方面效果最佳，其次是低频电刺激 (LFES) 结合 RAT。这为你的卒中患者上肢康复方案提供了有力的证据分级，特别是考虑整合神经刺激技术时。
items.titleZh: 神经刺激与技术增强型机器人辅助训练对卒中后上肢运动恢复的比较效应：一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖103项试验（5251名参与者）的系统综述和网络荟萃分析发现，在卒中后上肢运动功能恢复方面，重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）结合机器人辅助训练（RAT）比常规治疗使FMA-UE评分平均提高了9.56分（95% CI, 7.18-11.93），效果优于低频电刺激（LFES）加RAT（平均提高7.52分）和单纯RAT（平均提高3.83分）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis indicates that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with robot-assisted training (RAT) is most effective for post-stroke upper-limb motor recovery, followed by low-frequency electrical stimulation (LFES) plus RAT. This provides strong evidence to grade your upper-limb rehabilitation protocols for stroke patients, especially when integrating neurostimulation techniques.
items.limitation: 研究存在实质性异质性，且缺乏头对头比较的证据，导致最佳干预的确定性较低。
items.limitationEn: The study exhibited substantial heterogeneity and sparse head-to-head evidence, leading to low certainty in the definitive hierarchy of interventions.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation
